notes.title: Solfeggio in Google Play Market!
notes.content:
Solfeggio is also in the Google Play Market! Solfeggio can always be at hand!
Download: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.azzunyan.solfegio

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
- Fixed the size of characters on screens with an aspect ratio other than 16: 9.
- Fixed scrolling of the second page not reaching the end of the staff.
- Fixed scrolling of the second page breaking when using a screen with an aspect ratio other than 16: 9.
